full_prompt_en: The image is a square decorative illustration of a seated woman and three birds, in layered teal foliage with coral accents. Across the background, broad blue-green leaves, curling dark shapes and pale sage patches fill the space without a distant horizon. Small red blossoms and rounded blue flowers appear along the upper edge. At the upper left, a dark teal bird with a pale wing patch perches above the woman; another dark bird sits beside the chair along the left edge. In the upper right, a cream-white bird spreads its wings, its pointed beak facing left and its pale green underside curving toward a long tail at the right border. The woman occupies the centre, seated in a high-backed blue chair with a dark patterned inset and a broad pale blue rim. Her head turns slightly right, and her large blue-green eyes look upward toward the white bird. Near-black bobbed hair frames her peach-coloured face, with fine curved strands, round coral cheeks and small dark red lips. Her pale teal dress has a rounded neckline, short sleeves, fine leafy surface patterns and a darker ornamental band at the waist. Across the bottom, one bare forearm angles over her lap; the other descends beside her torso, with the hands partly hidden near the overlapping skirt. Coral flowers at the lower left and lower right, cream leaves along the right edge and pale oval blooms beside her shoulder enclose the chair. Fine etched lines and subtle grain enliven the otherwise flat colour shapes. The lighting is softly frontal and evenly diffused, brightening the face and dress against darker surrounding layers with only gentle modelling. The overall composition combines a calm central figure, lively birds and a dense ornamental border in a restrained cool palette punctuated by warm red.
full_prompt_zh: 这是一幅方形装饰性插画，一位坐姿女性与三只鸟置身层叠的青绿色枝叶中，珊瑚红点缀其间。背景遍布宽阔的蓝绿叶片、卷曲暗色形状与浅鼠尾草绿区域，没有远处的地平线。上缘散布红色小花和圆团状蓝花。左上方，一只带浅色翼斑的深青色鸟停在女性头顶上方；另一只深色鸟位于画面左缘、椅子旁。右上方，一只乳白色鸟展开双翼，尖喙朝左，淡绿色腹部曲线延伸至右边框附近的长尾。女性位于中央，坐在高背蓝椅中，椅背内层深暗并带纹样，外缘是宽阔的浅蓝色边框。她的头略转向右，大大的蓝绿色眼睛向上望着白鸟。近黑色齐颌短发围住桃色面容，发丝以细弧线描出，双颊呈圆形珊瑚红，嘴唇小巧而深红。浅青绿色连衣裙带圆领、短袖、纤细叶状纹样，腰部有一条较深的装饰带。画面下方，一侧裸露前臂斜放在膝上，另一侧手臂沿躯干垂下，双手在裙部交叠处局部被遮挡。左下与右下的珊瑚色花朵、右缘的奶油色叶片，以及肩旁浅色椭圆花形围住椅子。细密刻线般纹理与轻微颗粒丰富了整体平整的色形。光线柔和、从正面均匀散开，使脸与衣裙在周围较暗层次中明亮起来，仅有轻微的体积明暗。整体以安静的中央人物、灵动的鸟和繁密装饰边框组织画面，克制的冷色调由暖红色点亮。
style_prompt_en: Decorative illustration combines broad, flat silhouettes with fine incised-looking lines and a softly grained surface. Rounded contours and repeated curves interlock in dense layered arrangements, while a quieter central area provides a clear focal interval. Deep teal, muted blue-green and near-black form the largest colour masses; pale mint and cream bring separation, and small coral-red accents establish a warm counter-rhythm. Crisp outer edges coexist with delicate internal patterning and slight tonal variation rather than strong volumetric shading. Soft, even frontal light preserves the coloured shapes and gently brightens selected areas without dramatic cast shadows. The overall effect is ornamental and intimate, balancing dark enclosing density with lighter, clearly outlined forms.
style_prompt_zh: 装饰性插画将宽阔平整的剪影与细如刻线的内部纹理、轻柔颗粒表面结合起来。圆润轮廓和重复弧线在密集层叠中相互嵌合，较安静的中央区域留出明确的视觉焦点。深青色、低饱和蓝绿色和近黑色构成主要色块；浅薄荷绿与奶油色拉开层次，小面积珊瑚红形成暖色的呼应节奏。清晰的外边缘与精细内部纹样、轻微色调变化并存，不依赖强烈的体积塑造。柔和均匀的正面光保留色形，并轻轻提亮局部，没有戏剧性的投影。整体装饰感亲密而细致，在暗色包围的密度与浅色清晰轮廓之间取得平衡。
theme_en: A seated woman in a pale teal dress looks toward a white bird among dense foliage.
theme_zh: 浅青绿色衣裙的女性坐在繁密枝叶间，望向一只白鸟。
name: 夜园花叶人物插画
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
